customManagers.description: OmniRoute image is pinned by Chart.yaml appVersion. values.yaml sets tag: "" so the helm-values manager has nothing to anchor on. Quotes are optional in YAML, so match either style.

Images the binance-trading-bot chart bundles. Deliberately no manager for this chart's Chart.yaml appVersion: binance-trading-bot-sync.yml owns that field, because it also writes the Artifact Hub changelog from the upstream release notes. Two owners on one field means two PRs bumping to the same version, and the workflow's idempotency check only looks for its own branch name. Same split as github-app. Each is matched by name rather than by a generic repository/tag pattern, so adding an image to values.yaml is a deliberate act of adding it here too instead of silently inheriting update PRs.

bumpVersions.name: chart version
bumpVersions.description: ct.yaml sets check-version-increment, and release.yml rejects a changed chart under an existing tag. An appVersion-only PR fails CI. packageFileDir resolves to whichever chart the manager matched, so this covers every chart.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge appVersion patch bumps. The lint job is a required status check on main and the ruleset requires 0 approvals, so GitHub auto-merge waits for CI then merges. Minor and major wait for review.

Hold every bump 3 days so a withdrawn upstream release surfaces first. A longer window does not stall updates: Renovate walks releases newest-first and takes the first one older than the window, so the chart simply trails upstream by that much. 3 days is the chosen lag against upstream's 1-3 day cadence.
